model: OMEGA Seamaster Planet Ocean 600M Co-Axial Master Chronometer 42 mm 217.30.42.21.01.001 (42 mm steel, black dial, black ceramic bezel with serrated steel coin ring, steel bracelet)
note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot (at hand height). FOLLOWER/ADAPT of the Omega Diver 300M bracelet build (210.30.42.20.03.001): same step (watch_omega_diver300m), prep copy omega_planetocean42_prep; re-measured on this photo (12.95 px/mm from the 21 mm lug width / the 42 mm coin ring, pivot (512.1, 462.25), not the Diver's frame): serrated steel coin ring outside the black ceramic ring, steel flange inside it, solid arrow hour / minute hands and lozenge seconds hand, bigger crown, three-column bracelet (brushed outer, polished centre, brushed outer), no helium valve in the silhouette, angular lugs from the alpha.

case.note: integrated lugs: the case outline follows the photo silhouette (angular lugs, lug tops y 163.5 / bottoms y 775.5 px, crown guards at 3 o'clock), top and bottom sloping into the bracelet; the left silhouette at the case middle is the coin ring (42 mm)

bezel.note: black ceramic ring (insert_out radius) with the steel flange (bezel_in..bezel_in + chamfer_mm, sloped) inside it and the serrated steel coin ring (insert_out..bezel_out) outside it; numerals, minute dots, triangle, pip and the teeth come from the projected photo

hands.note: solid hands as signed outlines [mm along the hand from the pivot, signed lateral] traced from the photo in strips rotated about the pivot (threshold 110 of 255, nearest run to the axis; hour arrow tip 110.8 px / barbs 23 px half width, minute arrow tip 166.4 px / barbs 21.8 px, seconds shaft 2.4..3.2 px half width with a lozenge at 100..137 px and the end at 171.5 px; the hub zone is shaped from the visible stubs). The lume panels and the steel faces are texture (hands_photo = the projected photo); no separate lume polygons

crown.note: crown 7.1 mm tall (rows 422..514 px) with wide flutes, rounded cap; the crown guards above and below belong to the case silhouette

strap.note: strap.bracelet.columns left to right (3 columns: brushed outer link, polished centre link, brushed outer link, each with its own pieces_mm list): joints = centroids of the dark lines (grey < ~110) from brightness scans over the column centre bands of the 1x photo, top and bottom separately (rows converted with pivot y 462.25 and 12.95 px/mm); the stepped centre joints at the top (rows 119.5 / 137.8) are both kept, the double line at the bottom (rows 882 / 886) is one joint at 884; the outer columns start at the lug tips (23.0 top / 24.25 bottom), the centre column under the case at 20 mm; ends at the alpha ends (2 px inside). bounds_x_mm = the two vertical column boundaries [|y|, x1, x2] (dark gap centres, scan of rows 10..150 and 790..1010)

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass
